what_happened: Task 658's specs-ignore-lib.sh predicate and git check-ignore semantics fully determined the design (repo-root .gitignore write required, not specs/.gitignore); no new mechanism needed to be invented, and a live scratch-repo probe confirmed the exact placement requirement mechanically.

Plan authoring found test-init-specs.sh Case 6 is a live collision with this task's new default: it bootstraps a fresh fixture repo (no root .gitignore), commits specs/, and asserts check-runtime-file-tracking.sh exits 0 -- which breaks once the fresh-repo path writes a root /specs/ line, because Check C then sees durable provenance as ignored. Folded check-runtime-file-tracking.sh and both test files into the plan's scope rather than leaving the research report's Recommendation 6 as a deferred gap.
